item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 26/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Saola will linger over the seas east of Luzon and intensify gradually. A weak northeast monsoon will reach southern China next Tuesday and there will be more showers over the region. Saola is expected to move in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan and the coast of Fujian and eastern Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, but its movement remains uncertain. Under the combined effect of its outer subsiding air and the northeast monsoon, the weather will be very hot and dry over southern China. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
